releases.name: Tivano 2.5.32
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v2.5.32/Tivano-2.5.32.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

If Tivano 1.0.2 or earlier reports HTTP 403 while checking updates, install this DMG manually once. Later checks use public static feeds and do not require a GitHub login.

## English

## Bug fixes

- Removing or reordering a model preset, an MCP server variable or a project script while editing its text no longer crashes Tivano (#51).
- Long paragraphs with links in a finished conversation are no longer re-measured over and over, which could keep the CPU busy (#51).

## 简体中文

## 问题修复

- 编辑模型预设、MCP 服务器变量或项目脚本的文字时删除或拖动该行，Tivano 不再崩溃（#51）。
- 已完成对话里带链接的长段落不再被反复重新测量，避免因此持续占用 CPU（#51）。

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
